meta.title: Law 5282/2014 — Access to Information | National University of Concepción
meta.description: Public information in compliance with Law 5282/2014 on Free Citizen Access to Public Information and Government Transparency.

hero.title: Law 5282/2014
hero.description: In compliance with Article 8 of Law No. 5282/2014 «On Free Citizen Access to Public Information and Government Transparency», the National University of Concepción makes the minimum required information available to citizens.

docs.heading: Available public information
docs.description: Access the documents required by Article 8 of Law 5282/2014. Each document opens in a new tab, on the institutional service where it is published.
docs.emptyTitle: No documents have been published yet
docs.emptyText: The University is preparing the information for this law. Each category will show its document as soon as it is published.
docs.unavailableTitle: We could not load the information
docs.unavailableText: The content service is not responding right now. This does not mean the documents do not exist: please try again in a few minutes.

info.title: Commitment to access to information
info.description: The National University of Concepción publishes this information in compliance with Law 5282/2014 and guarantees the citizen right of access to public information.
